artist.name: Aleesha Creative
artist.bio: Digital illustrator and concept artist specializing in ethereal landscapes and character design. I blend soft palettes with intricate details to create immersive worlds that bridge the gap between dreams and reality. With over 5 years of experience in the digital art space, I focus on storytelling through color and light.

services.title: Custom Illustrations
services.description: High-quality custom digital paintings for your personal or commercial projects, from book covers to album art.

services.title: Character Design
services.description: Unique character concepts with full turnarounds, expression sheets, and personality profiles.

services.title: Environment Concept Art
services.description: Detailed background and environment designs for games, animation, and film productions.

services.title: Brand Visuals
services.description: Translating brand identities into stunning visual assets that resonate with your target audience.
